name: Build lantern-native against the current Chaos
body:
Dean (2026-11-14): mist install failed on macOS building lantern-native: ChaosUiBridge.cpp:539 error: no member named 'GameEngine' in 'Chaos::ChaosBuildTarget'. After that, mist run editor failed with NOX0424 unknown imports (I3dRenderer, Scene3d, Vector3 and others) in penumbra-bridge's Nox sources.

Cause: mist.lock pinned chaos-ui-framework at 74c7f61, which predates the GameEngine target ChaosUiBridge.cpp uses (#65). Chaos proto removed nothing: GameEngine is there, with UmbraEngine kept as an alias. Separately, the bridge's Nox sources import Scene3d, which the editor's nox.json did not list.

Done: mist.lock moved to the branch heads for chaos (c2fae12), cosmos, nyx, penumbra-bridge and penumbra-ui-engine (d8d3151), and apps/world-editor/nox/nox.json lists @penumbra-ui-engine/src/Scene3d. On Linux, mist install builds lantern-native and nox build --project apps/world-editor/nox succeeds with no errors. Still to confirm on macOS.
acceptance_criteria: mist install builds lantern-native from a clean mist.lock refresh.
ChaosUiBridge.cpp compiles against the current chaos, cosmos, nyx and penumbra-bridge heads.
